subject: [PATCH v2 7/8] selftests/nfsd: exercise listener_set request validation

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch adds a set of regression tests for the NFSD_CMD_LISTENER_SET command in the NFS daemon, specifically testing the validation of listener requests. The tests cover various scenarios such as bad or absent transport names, missing addresses, and malformed entries. The tests are run in their own network namespace to isolate them from the host's nfsd registrations. This patch is part of a larger series that also includes tests for creating services and registering with rpcbind.
